# A whipped damsel's hop counts as a throw (851-3527, docs/quirks.md §1), and the wiki clip
# quirks/damsel-whip-hop-thrown. A staged scene (written by wiki-clips --replays from a scene spec,
# docs/wiki-media.md): it boots, loads this custom level from the title's load-level menu (240), and plays the
# scene's inputs from 241, its frame 0. The player (@) walks right up to a damsel (D) and whips her (X, 281):
#   1111111111111111111111111111111
#   1000000000000000000000000000001
#   ...  (5 rows like it)
#   1000@000D0000000000000000000001
#   1111111111111111111111111111111
#   1111111111111111111111111111111
# oDamsel's collision with the whip (282) sets yVel -2 and hit 10 and doesn't hurt her. Falling back she reaches
# yVel 2.2 (289), and her step's not held and yVel > 2 and status != THROWN makes her THROWN (status 2), which
# counts her in damselsGrabbed. A throw sets counter to stunMax (120); this one keeps her cry-for-help
# countdown, 151 then, so she lies stunned from her landing (bounced, 290; counter 150) until it runs out, and
# runs (status 1) at 443: 154 steps after she was made THROWN. Ends at 500.
# story: oDamsel.hit=10@282..282 oDamsel.status=2@289..289 damselsGrabbed=1@289..289 oDamsel.counter=150@290..290
# story: oDamsel.status=1@443..443 !oDamsel.status=1@..442 !oDamsel.hp<4 !held=oDamsel
